A '''Droid''' is a [[Character]] with ability 0. Droids have a Droid icon and are not Rebels, Imperials, or aliens unless other game text says so.

Premiere examples: [[2X-3KPR (Tooex)]], [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)]], [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix)]] (Dark Side).
